# Dr. Himadri Sahoo

## Scientist | Quantum & Complex Photonic Systems


*Harnessing nonlinear and non-Hermitian dynamics
for the next generation of photonic technologies.*

I am a scientist exploring quantum and complex
photonic systems, driven by a curiosity to
understand, control, and harness the dynamics
of light.

Currently, I am a Postdoctoral Researcher
in the Nonlinear NanoPhotonics Group at the
University of Twente, Netherlands.

:::


::::
